chunks: By this chain of narration, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Whoever separates from the Muslim community has indeed removed the yoke of Islam from his neck. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, what is the Muslim community? He said: The community of the people of truth, even if they are few.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the true Muslim community?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad defines the true Muslim community as 'the people of truth, even if they are few,' warning that whoever separates from this community has removed the yoke of Islam from their neck. This hadith, addressed to the Companions, establishes that authenticity of community is measured by adherence to truth rather than numerical majority.
